Each network below is an MLP with 12 binary inputs x0..x11 (each 0 or 1), one ReLU hidden layer, and one output logit (output = 1 if logit > 0, else 0). For EACH network, decide which boolean function it computes over all 4096 inputs. Options (same for every network):
A: output = x2 AND x5
B: output = x2 OR x5
C: output = x2 XOR x5
D: output = x2 AND (NOT x5)
E: output = MAJORITY(x0, x3, x7)
F: output = x0 AND x3 AND x7
G: output = x0 OR x3 OR x7
H: output = PARITY(x0, x3, x7)  (1 if an odd number are 1)
I: none of the above (the network computes some other function)

Networks are independent; any option may appear any number of times, including I. Note that several options share the same inputs, so knowing which inputs matter is not enough.
